He pinned the note beside the lantern room window and watched the horizon until dark, wondering if someone out there was still waiting for an answer.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市沉入一种暧昧的寂静。路灯还亮着，橘黄的光晕落在空旷的柏油路上，像是被遗忘的叹息。远处，早点铺的蒸笼已经冒出白气，模糊了玻璃窗。一辆洒水车缓缓驶过，轮胎碾过积水的声响在楼宇间回荡。几只流浪猫蹲在巷口，眼睛在黑暗中亮如琥珀。环卫工人弯腰扫过落叶，扫帚与地面摩擦出粗粝的节奏。这座城市还没有醒来，却已经开始呼吸——在黎明到来之前，所有的温柔都藏在无人注意的角落里。", "w03": "• Recursion is when a function solves a problem by calling itself with a smaller version of the same problem — like looking up a word in the dictionary and finding the definition uses another word you also need to look up.\n• Every recursive function needs a \"base case\" — a point where it stops calling itself and just gives a simple answer, like finally finding a word you already know.\n• Think of it like Russian nesting dolls: you keep opening smaller dolls inside bigger ones until you reach the tiniest doll that doesn't open, and then you put them all back together to get your answer."}
